What does hydrophilic mean?

answers.a: Water-loving: the substance or the part of the molecule dissolves well in water
answers.d: Water-hating: does not dissolve in water

questions.question: What does hydrophobic mean?

answers.a: Water-fearing: the substance or the part of the molecule does not dissolve in water

questions.question: Which part of a soap molecule is hydrophilic and which part is hydrophobic?

answers.b: The head is hydrophobic, the tail is hydrophilic
answers.d: The head is hydrophilic, the tail is hydrophobic

answers.c: The heads are in the fat and the tails stick out into the water
answers.d: The soap dissolves the fat into a gas
